method: Whole selection articles resampled multinomial(A,1/A), one draw shared by all seeds of a site/arm; seed vertices resampled as in summary.seed_bootstrap_matrix; decoders, alive masks and the 0.70 threshold held fixed.
caveats: Percentile bootstrap, marginal per cell. No simultaneous or familywise coverage claim.
Conditional on the frozen decoders and on the test-evaluation union chosen from the unresampled corpus.
Model sites are a chosen set, not a random sample of language models; no corpus-generalization claim beyond the sampled articles.
Article draws and seed draws are both nonparametric; with 30-40 articles and 10 seeds neither axis is asymptotically comfortable.
